meta_title: Firmo — your quotes from a voice note
meta_description: Send your sale as a voice note, a photo or a text; get a professional quote. Your prices, our presentation.
home_promise: Say your sale. Get a quote you are proud to send.
link_expired_title: This link is no longer valid
link_expired_body: It was already used or it expired. Write "space" to Firmo to get a new one.
chat_welcome: Welcome to Firmo. Send me your sale as a voice note, a photo or a text: I'll prepare a quote you'll be proud to send.
chat_share_number: To start, share your number with the button below: it opens your account, with no password.
chat_contact_refused: I can only use your own number. Press "Share my number".
chat_unsupported: I read text messages, voice notes and photos. Send me your sale in one of these forms.
chat_degraded_voice: I got your voice note but couldn't add it to the draft. Your draft is kept: try again in a moment or write the key details.
chat_degraded_photo: I got your photo but couldn't read it. Your draft is kept: write me the key details and I'll add them.
chat_degraded_text: I hit a technical problem, but your draft is kept. Try again in a moment.
chat_issue_proposal: Here is the preview. Shall I issue it with its final number?
chat_issue_cancelled: All right, it stays a draft. Tell me what to change.
chat_space_link:
Your Firmo space: {url}
This link works once and expires in 10 minutes.
chat_ask_issuer_name: Under which name should this quote go out?
action_refused: This action is not possible for this document.
clause_refused: Give the clause a title and a text.
clauses_intro: Your conditions, written once, carried on your documents.
document_issue_confirm: Issue this document? Its number will be final and it can no longer be changed.
document_issue_refused: The document changed or is incomplete: look at the preview again.
document_not_issuable: Something is still missing before issuing.
document_save_refused: I could not save: check the amounts and labels.
documents_search: Search a client, a subject or a number
home_empty: No document yet: send your first sale in the conversation.
home_intro: Find, correct or download what you created in the conversation.
logo_hint: PNG or JPG; it heads your documents.
logo_refused: I could not use this image: send a PNG or a JPG.
numbering_intro: Changing the format never resets a counter.
numbering_refused: This format is not possible: letters, digits, - _ / . only.
payment_refused: This payment exceeds the balance or is incomplete.
presentation_intro: This information is carried on your next documents.
presentation_preview_after_name: The preview appears once your name is saved.
presentation_preview_alt: Preview of a document's first page with your presentation
presentation_refused: I could not save: check the name and the percentages.
profile_color_hint: It shows on your documents, never in the app.
share_ready: Send this link to your client: it opens this document only, read-only.
chat_privacy_note: Your voice notes and photos are not kept: I only keep what I read from them, in your space. Your prices serve your documents only.
